subject.title: [Feature]: Semantic Message Aggregation: merge rapid-fire short messages and split multi-topic long messages

question: Should OpenClaw add semantic topic splitting and adaptive aggregation as a core/session-ingress capability, keep only fixed inbound debounce plus narrower follow-up trackers, or route semantic preprocessing to a plugin/API seam first?
rationale: The remaining request changes cross-channel turn boundaries and adds public config/API surface, so automation cannot safely choose topic-splitting behavior, timing defaults, transcript metadata, or rollout scope.

options.title: Narrow Generic Ingress Design
options.body: Approve one opt-in generic ingress or bundle contract, preserve current defaults, and keep semantic splitting behind explicit schema, docs, and representative channel tests.

options.title: Defer Semantic Splitting
options.body: Keep this open as product backlog, let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/57123 own adaptive timing, and do not add semantic topic analysis yet.

options.title: Declare Fixed Debounce Sufficient
options.body: Document messages.inbound as the supported core answer and route semantic preprocessing experiments to plugins or external integrations.

recommendation.title: Narrow Generic Ingress Design
recommendation.body: Approve one opt-in generic ingress or bundle contract, preserve current defaults, and keep semantic splitting behind explicit schema, docs, and representative channel tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest shared-policy and product-review history across inbound debounce, ordering, and queue-adjacent behavior.
